# Supreme Adventures

> Supreme Adventures is a premier East African tour operator based in Nairobi, Kenya, offering authentic wildlife safaris, beach getaways, overland truck parties, and custom adventure itineraries across Kenya and Tanzania.

## Core Packages & Destinations
- [Maasai Mara Safaris](https://supremeadventures.com/#upcoming): Witness the Great Wildebeest Migration & Big Five game drives in Kenya's legendary game reserve.
- [Zanzibar Beach Escapes](https://supremeadventures.com/#destinations): Tropical white sand beaches, Stone Town culture tours, and traditional dhow sailing.
- [Amboseli Elephant Kingdom](https://supremeadventures.com/#destinations): Iconic elephant herd safaris beneath Mount Kilimanjaro.
- [Lakes Baringo & Bogoria Overland Party](https://supremeadventures.com/#upcoming): Group overland truck party adventures and geysers excursion.
- [Coastal Safaris](https://supremeadventures.com/#destinations): Diani, Mombasa, Malindi, and Lamu Island cultural getaways.

## Services
- Bespoke Safari Expeditions
- Custom Group Overland Trips
- Flight & 4x4 Transfer Logistics
- Beach Holiday Accommodations
